description: Image Description: The image displays a simple, hand-drawn numeral "8" on a plain white background. The digit is rendered in a single continuous line, with a slightly irregular and uneven stroke that suggests it was drawn freehand. The top loop of the "8" is somewhat larger and more rounded than the bottom loop, and the line thickness varies slightly, indicating a natural drawing motion. The overall appearance is informal and not perfectly symmetrical, with minor wobbles and variations in curvature.
